title: The optimal one-third stability exponent for compact-target Brenier maps
exact_target: Fix $d\geq 2$, a convex body $K\subset R^d$ with nonempty interior, its uniform probability rho, and a compact target set Y. Is there C(K,Y) such that $||T_\mu -T_\nu ||_(L2(\rho ))\leq C$ $W_2(\mu ,\nu )^{1/3}$ for every pair of target probability measures on Y, including atomic and singular measures? Is no larger universal exponent possible even for cube source and target and exactly three target atoms?
